item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q012_not_true_family_specific_pair","answer":"Homology is not established by their SCOPe 2.08 classification. d1s9za_ (Amyloidogenic design-1; SUNID 98768) and d1hqja_ (Unnamed design-1; SUNID 61142) both belong to the nominal family k.40.1.1, Designed trimeric coiled-coil (SUNID 100905), but that family explicitly carries the annotation “not a true family.” They also share superfamily k.40.1, fold k.40, and class k (Designed proteins). Here, the shared hierarchy groups synthetic designs with similar architecture; it does not establish common evolutionary ancestry. Ordinary family/superfamily homology expectations—and the API’s generic homology_implied_by_level flag—must be qualified by the explicit family caveat. Fold and class membership alone do not imply homology.
